subject.name: Arctura Base
subject.role: open-source ARM validator and miner implementation

network.name: Bittensor local testnet
network.scope: documented local testnet launch and bounded runtime exercise
network.mainnet_status: not published; no Finney launch is claimed

claims.assertion: Arctura Base was launched and exercised as a local Bittensor testnet subnet on netuid 505.
claims.evidence_level: primary implementation repository and first-party operations records
claims.boundary: The public record documents a local testnet launch. It does not include an external explorer or metagraph snapshot for independent historical confirmation.

claims.assertion: The documented bounded run reached a live miner state and a live validator loop that issued a mandate on netuid 505.
claims.boundary: The same record says that the miner was not running concurrently during the bounded validator run, so no miner response was observed; short-run weight setting may not have been attempted.

claims.assertion: The implementation, operational scripts, and test plan are publicly available in the Arctura Base repository.
claims.boundary: Published code and instructions do not by themselves prove an unrecorded historical chain event.

claims.assertion: No active Finney netuid, emissions state, or mainnet availability is claimed.
claims.boundary: A local Bittensor testnet launch is not a Finney-mainnet launch claim.
